name: OmniEstate stale global staking reward
summary: The staking pool reuses the prior investment's global reward when an unsupported duration or a stake below 10,000 ORT skips every reward-calculation branch. A new caller can use an unsupported duration to withdraw immediately and mint that stale reward repeatedly.

loss.notes: Gross ORT/WBNB reserve depletion across all identified reward-mint and disposal transactions, excluding identifiable attacker pool inputs. Minted ORT is financing/dilution, not stolen existing ORT principal; routed quote assets and token quantities are not valued again. No recovery or external financing fee, builder payment or gas is deducted.

ageReset.description: Latest implementation selection; predecessor implementations retain the same reward defect. Mint permission and unpause precede this activation; later ordinary investments change reward size, not branch safety.

OwnershipTransferred logs show deployer EOA then Safe 0xa789b72ec75fe2a4a9ba76ca089d90419d6c05ad at 16148342/16148348 for token/pool. First exercise/scope review: Etherscan V2 getLogs(proxy, [13454612,99999999], Invest topic 0x791e3f3b44d31b3bfd9aa819979569c0f4efbee01fc0c25b063635ac36385f55, pages 1-5, offset 1000) returns 4172 events. Predicate (duration not in {3,6,12,24} OR amountStaked<10000e18) AND reward>0 finds 4025 erroneous credits to 16 callers. All preceding credits enter a reward-assignment branch. First is source-7: lock 138, 1000 ORT, duration 24, expiry 1736988296, stale 6000 ORT reward; caller 0x7efc1491dba397d4998f6ea72070f94f2ac6a50a intent is unknown. Successful wrongful entitlement creation anchors the episode without requiring redemption. Source-1 later credits lock 139 with 6000 ORT for one transferred ORT wei/zero expiry; its first withdrawal tx 0xa916674fb8203fac6d78f5f9afc604be468a514aa61ea36c6d6ef26ecfbd0e97 returns that wei and mints 6000 ORT. All three verified StakingPool implementations retain total_percent when no calculation branch assigns it. Complete similarly paginated Claim and Withdraw histories each contain 4084 events; 4022 claims match erroneous lock IDs and mint 54329170251.782465604251229580 ORT to 15 redeemers. Erroneous locks 138,179,1460 have no claim. Last erroneous claim is source-10 at block 24860588; no subsequent recurrence in histories through 99999999. Tail eth_getLogs for Invest/Claim and txlist [100000000,125820045] return zero, closing the API upper bound at observed head 125820045.

Loss review: Etherscan V2 getLogs(ORT 0x1d64327c74d6519afef54e58730ad6fc797f05ba, Transfer topic 0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef) in consecutive 1000-block windows [24850000,24870999], paginated offset 1000, is complete. Define S as the unique union of the 15 source-5 erroneous-claim recipient addresses (Claim topic1) and the five incident.attackerAddresses. Select ORT Transfer logs whose topic1 sender or topic2 recipient is in S; their distinct transaction hashes yield 339 successful receipts. Complete recipient txlist histories and each EOA ORT tokentx [24850000,99999999] close dispositions: EOA token histories contain 22/121/12/0/0 rows for the five listed actors and end by 24859475; four tested EOAs have zero ORT balance at 24850508/24870999. Helpers return minted ORT to these EOAs or dispose within the claim receipt; retained 10/1000 ORT is supplied seed inventory, plus wei dust. Receipt 0x26f919de39b88a6e71d67d5b20a01bb67a9f567749175ed34984f5e40ce3edeb independently confirms ff9ab8 invokes 50 mint/sell cycles through helper 0x558af3ea4d08726221a7612c0ab32f5c94bfcc2b. The 339 receipts have 17 Swap emitters; historical token0/token1 queries identify only 0x6e8ef155ea3cd56d0eaebaced57f45d93c8a2a31 as an ORT pair (token1=WBNB). For each receipt, sum WBNB Transfer out of this pool minus into it; all equal Swap amount1Out-amount1In. 57 nonzero receipts sum 263611391191517822977 wei: positive receipt depletion 263689221236452913957 minus net input receipts 77830044935090980. Source-12 contains all 57 material reserve-movement receipts. Identifiable attacker WBNB inputs, including intra-receipt financing purchases, are excluded from victim depletion. None of the 612 ORT-pair Swap events has both amount1In and amount1Out: no WBNB loan repayment/fee to this pool is deducted. No later recovery, gas, builder payment or external financing fee is deducted, so the remaining quantity isolates gross existing-victim WBNB depletion. Other routed assets are swaps of these proceeds and are not added. Unclaimed reward credits do not deplete reserves; minted residual dust is not existing victim principal. Final disposition is source-10, timestamp 1673946637. Source-11 historical endpoint requests that time; quote timestamp 1673946625, BNB price $302.0207169674215, yielding $79616.10.
